C9000239.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 239 (Sharp singularity rates for symmetric random sign matrices.; papers: The sharp exponential rate of singularity for symmetric Bernoulli matrices; The sharp singularity rate for biased symmetric sign matrices; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

U_MAIN.statement: For unbiased symmetric sign matrices A_n, Pr(det A_n=0)=2^(-n+o(n)); U sections/01-introduction.tex:7-15.

B_MAIN.statement: For every fixed p in (0,1) except 1/2, lim Pr(det A_n^(p)=0)^(1/n)=p^2+(1-p)^2; B sections/01-introduction.tex:8-17.

U_REDUCTION.statement: Unbiased corank reduction and admissible-column reduction in U Section 2.

U_LATTICE.statement: U Section 3: quotient determinant identities, height submodularity, normal-height identity, stable quotient extraction, robust extraction and height.

U_TYPICAL.statement: U Section 5: simultaneous typical ranks, inverse-rank, prime-corank and spectrum estimates.

U_DISCRIMINANT.statement: U Section 6: discriminant blocks, primary coloring, colored-image orders and pairing determinant.

U_PRICING.statement: U Sections 7-10: gated minor moves, layer inequalities, cube concentration, witness/certificate pricing and retention cost.

B_REDUCTION.statement: B Section 2: corank-one reduction and the central admissible-column bound.

B_PRIME.statement: Typically, all relevant nonsingular bit matrices have F_q corank at most N^(3/5) for every prime q; B Section 3.

B_INTERSECTION.statement: B Section 4: simultaneous Boolean-cube intersection bound <2^(alpha N) for all cosets of intermediate lattices K with index at least N^(ell^(-D)N).

B_STATIC.statement: If W_2(B)<=zeta then the admissible-column set S_L0(B) has cardinality at most 2^(e_0 N); B Section 5.

B_RETENTION.statement: B Section 6: costly path extensions and specified retention events have probability at most 2^(-N(a-2e_0)); width-two gates cost its square in the stated regime.

C_HEIGHT_COVER.statement: For fixed D,A>0 and all sufficiently large N, uniformly for 0<=m<=N, all rational W with H(W)<=exp(N ell^D) are within rank distance N ell^(-A) of a W-independent list of at most 2^(N^2 ell^(-A)) rational subspaces.

L_HEIGHT_CHAIN.statement: The greatest minimizers of log_N H(U)+a d(U,P_s) form a descending chain, with terminal distance <=h(W)/a and total dimensions of multi-drops <=4h(W)/a.

L_NORMAL_BALANCE.statement: Every transition normal lattice obeys det L>=N^(-a rank L) in the ambient dual lattice and det K/det K'<=N^(a(c-rank K')) for every primitive K' in K.

L_EXPENSIVE.statement: Shortest projected normal flags have O(ac) positions with log_N mu_i>1/2-3a and none if c=1, with constants uniform over actual transitions.

L_VECTOR_COUNT.statement: Given a valid flag prefix, the next image costs O(1+N^(1-2a)log^2 N) bits if inexpensive or O(a N log N) otherwise; its fiber costs O((c/a)log N) bits.

L_ENCODING.statement: Adaptive flag choices reconstruct each transition and the terminal space; summing all costs yields o(N^2 ell^(-A)) and terminal distance o(N ell^(-A)), uniformly for m<=N.

L_FLAG_AMORTIZATION.statement: For a>=0 and q>0, every finite family of real block lengths u_i>=1 with total length <=c, total excess <=0, short-block excess >=u_i/5 and long-block excess >=-4 a u_i has at most (20 a+1/q)c blocks; if a>=1/q it has at most 21 a c. The source also proves the stated multi-drop, square-sum, and entropy identities with their nonzero denominator hypotheses.

C_QUANT_COVER.statement: For integers N>=16, L=log N, 0<a<=1/40, a>=N^(-2/5), a L>=log(10(L+2)), b>=0, and every 0<=m<=N, the rational subspaces W with log H(W)<=b admit a W-independent rank-metric cover of radius b/(a L) and log_2 cardinality at most ceil(10000[N L+N^2 N^(-2a)(L+2)^2+a N b+b^2/(a^3 L)]).

C_LOGPOWER_COVER.statement: For all sufficiently large integers N and every 0<=m<=N, all rational W with log H(W)<=N(log N)^(1/9) have a W-independent cover of radius N(log N)^(-2/3) and log_2 cardinality at most 100000 N^2(log N)^(-1/9).

L_COVER_RATES.statement: Substituting a=(log N)^(-2/9), b=N(log N)^(1/9) into Theorem Q yields radius N(log N)^(-2/3) and dominant entropy powers (log N)^(-1/9). For all fixed real D,A>0 these eventually cover exp(N(log log N)^D) heights with both exact bounds of the staged low-height-cover theorem, uniformly for m<=N.
